source.method: Independent ZIP extraction and SHA256 recomputation from original file bytes; Pillow RGB/ICC and exact-ratio 390×240 and 390×520 contain vs center-cover/focal crops, inspected in a diagnostic contact sheet

instructions: No automatic production object-fit policy change; diagnostic frames are not the actual app container
Retained source image area is a geometric metric, not subjective quality approval
The prior global claim that all Saint Clare centered crops are unsuitable is overbroad: Cima works better in wide than portrait, while Bishop work works better in portrait than wide
Absence of ICC is not proof that colours are wrong; avoid asserting calibrated color accuracy
No new assignment, source image asset in Pages, Commons imports, or release permission

rows.label: Costanzi — Miracle of St Joseph of Cupertino
rows.recommendation: contain on 390×240; portrait cover may be provisionally viable but preserve full image if affordance permits

rows.label: Cima — Madonna and Child with Francis and Clare
rows.recommendation: wide cover possible after owner composition check; portrait should contain entire horizontal painting

rows.label: Bishop of Assisi Giving Palm to St Clare
rows.recommendation: contain on 390×240; portrait cover only with subject-safe framing and authorisation

rows.label: Fetti — Parable of the Mote and Beam
rows.recommendation: portrait cover viable pending app rendering; wide crop optional only if not misrepresented as complete painting
